name: umoci-configurable-layer-compression-profiles
instr:
umoci cannot configure gzip, zstd, or uncompressed OCI layers through one compression profile shared by its library and commands. Add canonical metadata and reproducible encoder choices without changing profile-free behavior.

`CompressionSetting` and `CompressionProfile` must be copy-safe and distinguish an unspecified profile from `DefaultProfile(algorithm)`. `ProfileError` carries the algorithm, setting, value, and underlying error. `ResolveProfile` selects a registered `ProfiledAlgorithm` by suffix, then validates and normalizes settings before reading input. Gzip supports level, block-size, and concurrency together; zstd supports level and concurrency; noop rejects transformational settings. Each successful `CompressProfile` stream must round-trip byte for byte through the existing decoder and return its canonical effective profile. Invalid combinations must not consume input.

Profiled mutation records `CompressionProfileAnnotation`, parseable by `ParseProfileAnnotation`, while keeping stored bytes, descriptor digest and size, media type, DiffID, annotations, and one non-empty history entry consistent. `GenerateLayerProfiled` preserves tar ordering and whiteouts while passing the effective profile into mutation. `RepackProfiled` applies it without partial publication.

Repack and insert use the same named profile vocabulary, reject settings with ambiguous automatic selection, and validate before opening mutation output. Invalid profiles leave the existing reference, pub
